001package dev.nandi0813.api.Interface;
002
003import dev.nandi0813.api.Enum.NameLocation;
004import net.kyori.adventure.text.Component;
005import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
006
007/**
008 * Adds components before or after a player's name wherever ZonePractice Pro renders it.
009 * {@link NameLocation#CHAT} is requested from the async chat thread, so implementations must be thread-safe
010 * and must not call the Bukkit API for that location.
011 */
012public interface NameDecorator {
013
014    /**
015     * Unique id, lowercase [a-z0-9_-], e.g. "myaddon_nametags".
016     * @return The id, never null
017     */
018    String getId();
019
020    /**
021     * Component placed before the player's prefix. Nullable.
022     * @param player The player whose name is rendered
023     * @param location Where the name is rendered
024     * @return The component, or null for none
025     */
026    Component getPrefix(Player player, NameLocation location);
027
028    /**
029     * Component placed after the player's suffix. Nullable.
030     * @param player The player whose name is rendered
031     * @param location Where the name is rendered
032     * @return The component, or null for none
033     */
034    Component getSuffix(Player player, NameLocation location);
035
036    /**
037     * Lower values are rendered closer to the name.
038     * @return The priority, 0 by default
039     */
040    default int getPriority() {
041        return 0;
042    }
043
044}
